description:
About Stepful:

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.


Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.


Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.


Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

Our values:

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

  • Care first: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

  • Learn quickly: We test, learn with data, and iterate.

  • Build together: We win when we rely on each other.

  • Own it: We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

The opportunity:

Stepful’s Ohio Practical Nursing program is growing, and we’re investing in curriculum that reflects the latest in nursing education and NCLEX-PN preparation. We’re looking for an experienced nurse educator to join us as an independent consultant on a focused, high-impact project. You’ll lead a program-wide update to our assessment and grading approach, timed to our scheduled Ohio Board of Nursing site visit in mid-December, and you’ll refresh our capstone Transition to Practice & NCLEX Prep course for our next cohort. Success looks like a consistent, outcomes-driven assessment structure across the program and a capstone course that gives students a strong, confident path to licensure.

This is a fully remote contract engagement running from contract signing through December 18, 2026, with the option to extend into Q1 2027. You’ll partner with our VP of Learning, who sponsors the engagement, along with our Ohio PN Program Director, Dean of Nursing, and Learning Program Management team.

What you’ll do:

Assessment and grading strategy

  • Review grading and assessment structures across our PN course sequence and scope the update, with time estimates

  • Design a standardized, program-wide grading framework that puts summative exams at the center of student evaluation, for Program Director approval

  • Update syllabi, the student handbook, course calendars, and rubrics to reflect the new framework, and write LMS specifications for our team to build

  • Review exam blueprints and item analysis data to keep assessments aligned to course outcomes and the current NCLEX-PN test plan

  • Prepare a concise summary of the update, its rationale, and course-by-course progress for our Ohio Board of Nursing site visit, and be available for questions during the visit

Capstone course refresh (Transition to Practice & NCLEX Prep)

  • Integrate ATI and NCLEX preparation from the first week of the course

  • Bring in test-taking strategy content and focused readings, and center the capstone project on clinical judgment

  • Deliver an updated syllabus, calendar, assignment directions, rubrics, and LMS build specifications

Curriculum framework

  • Recommend a modern organizing framework grounded in current nursing education best practices, and align program, course, and assignment objectives to it

What you’ll bring:

  • MSN or higher from a nationally accredited program

  • 3+ years of clinical nursing practice

  • 2+ years teaching in a pre-licensure nursing program, ideally PN

  • A track record of developing or revising nursing courses, syllabi, grading schemas, and exam blueprints

  • Working knowledge of at least one national nursing accreditation standard (ACEN, CCNE, or CNEA)

  • Familiarity with the current NCLEX-PN test plan and Next Generation NCLEX item formats

  • Availability to start right away and deliver against firm milestones through December 18 (we estimate about 20 hours per week)

  • Clear writing and strong organization, with the ability to scope, prioritize, and deliver independently on a tight timeline

Bonus points if:

  • You’ve prepared for an Ohio Board of Nursing site visit or curriculum change submission

  • You have experience with ATI products and integrating standardized testing into PN curricula

  • You’ve taught NCLEX remediation or test-taking strategy (e.g., Saunders)

  • You hold the NLN Certified Nurse Educator (CNE) credential

  • You’ve used item analysis or exam analytics tools like ExamSoft

  • You’ve supported nursing programs across multiple states

Interview Process:

  • Introductory call with a Talent Acquisition team member

  • Interview with our VP of Learning and Ohio PN Program Director

  • Brief review of a curriculum or assessment sample from your past work

The hourly rate range for this 1099 independent contractor opportunity is $50.00/hour. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, internal pay equity and other relevant business considerations.

Stepful is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

--

In light of recent hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you directly from an @stepful.com email address to guide you through our interview process.
